context: Boss and manager discuss removing unfair practices and tightening compliance
purpose: Teach: 鈴木/配布/交付/給与/口座/同社/同一/排除

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健二くん、朝日新聞によると、ある大手企業で給与の不正があったらしいな。同社の対応を見ていると、うちも他人事ではないぞ。
lines.en: Kenji, according to the Asahi Shimbun, a major corporation apparently had salary irregularities. Watching that company's response, this isn't someone else's problem for us either.
lines.style: Grave opening tone, measured authoritative delivery from senior boss

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、私もその記事を読みました。一部の幹部だけを優遇して、給与の振込口座まで別扱いにしていたそうですね。
lines.en: Yes, I read that article too. Apparently they were favoring only certain executives, even handling their salary deposit accounts separately.
lines.style: Deferential agreement, careful and concerned reporting manner

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うちの社員には全員、同一の基準を適用しなければならん。不公平な慣行は徹底的に排除したい。
lines.en: We must apply the exact same standards to all our employees. I want to thoroughly eliminate unfair practices.
lines.style: Firm directive tone, leaning forward with conviction

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: では、新しいコンプライアンス規程を作成して、全部署に配布いたしましょうか。
lines.en: Then shall I draft new compliance regulations and distribute them to every department?
lines.style: Proactive suggestion, polite and slightly eager problem-solving

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼む。それから、社員証の再交付の手続きも見直してくれ。身元確認をきちんとしたい。
lines.en: Please do. Also, review the reissuance procedure for employee IDs. I want proper identity verification.
lines.style: Crisp instruction, ticking through items efficiently

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。退職者の古い口座情報がまだ残っているケースもあるので、早めに整理いたします。
lines.en: Understood. There are also cases where old account information of former employees still remains, so I'll clean those up promptly.
lines.style: Affirmative response with attentive practical follow-through

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。仮に監査が入っても恥ずかしくない体制にしておきたいんだ。
lines.en: Good. I want to have a system in place that won't embarrass us even if an audit comes.
lines.style: Reflective and resolute, weighty closing-thought delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。経理部の鈴木さんとも連携して、来週までに素案をお見せします。
lines.en: Exactly as you say. I'll coordinate with Mr. Suzuki from accounting as well, and show you a draft by next week.
lines.style: Crisp committed wrap-up, confident professional reassurance
